ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 23, 2026--


[Repay Holdings Corporation (NASDAQ: RPAY)](https://repay.com/) ("REPAY" or the "Company"), a leading provider of bill payment solutions, today announced that it will host an Investor Day on December 7, 2026, in New York City.


Members of REPAY's leadership team will present the Company's financial and strategic outlook, as well as its shared future with KUBRA Data Transfer LTD ("KUBRA"). The event will feature senior leadership from REPAY's business segments and KUBRA and will include a live question-and-answer session.


Presentations will begin at 10:00 a.m. ET. A live webcast of the event will be available to the public on the Company's Investor Relations website, and a replay of the webcast will be available following the event.


**About REPAY**


[REPAY](https://repay.com/) provides integrated bill payment solutions to verticals that have specific transaction processing needs. REPAY's proprietary, integrated payment technology provides a comprehensive end-to-end platform offering digital payments, bill design & presentment, and communication services for clients, while enhancing the overall experience for consumers and businesses.
